page.overview:
Who is Professor Z's helicopter?

Professor Z's Helicopter is a minor character in Cars 2.

In Cars 2, Professor Z's Helicopter appears in Porto Corsa, where he captures Finn McMissile with a giant magnet and, off-screen, brings him to London.

In Cars 2: The Video Game, Professor Z's Helicopter is mainly used as the Professor's main way of transportation. He appears in all Survival and Hunter missions, Pipeline Sprint, and Runway Tour.

Players have the ability to destroy him and Professor Z in the last wave of any Hunter mission. However, that is only possible on the Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 versions of the game.
